name: usage-pulse
description: Local passive usage telemetry for Claude Code, Codex, and Kimi Code sessions.

interface.longDescription: Usage Pulse passively records local per-session usage counters across AI coding providers and exposes summaries through MCP.

skillInstructions: Use Usage Pulse only for local usage summaries and hygiene. Do not estimate pay-as-you-go spend.

hooks.command: py -3 -c "import os,runpy,sys; root=os.environ.get('KIMI_PLUGIN_ROOT') or os.getcwd(); sys.argv=['plugin-hook', 'SessionStart', '--provider', 'kimi']; sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(root,'src')); runpy.run_path(os.path.join(root, 'hooks/session_start.py'), run_name='__main__')"
